name: coder
description: Coder agent. Implements one bounded change end to end: features, fixes, refactors and multi-file edits, with their tests and the docs the change makes stale. Callers pass `model` and `effort` on every call: haiku/medium for mechanical or fully specified edits, sonnet/medium by default, sonnet/high for concurrency, data or core invariants, opus/high only after a sonnet attempt failed or for work that cannot be split further.
